description: Ex RAF EE553 (G-5-119), on charge 23 August 1948, C-019 from 1959, last flight 17 December 1968, retired 12 March 1971 and donated to the city in 1973-74; long painted as I-021, sandblasted and repainted in original colours with new lighting from November 2020.
aliases: Meteor F4; Meteor F Mk 4; C-019; I-021; EE553; C019; I021
